input.subject: [E21] Missing HDMI Dell Alienware
input.body: Hey ByteMart, I received my Dell Alienware AW3423DWF today. The box was well sealed and does not appear to have been tampered with or opened, but the HDMI cable is missing from the box. Could you please arrange to send the missing cable or advise me on the next steps?
